primary_endpoint: Mean change in hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) from baseline to Week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Mean HVPG change: −0.48 mmHg (5 mg), −0.81 mmHg (25 mg), and −0.70 mmHg (50 mg), versus −0.18 mmHg with placebo; statistical significance was not reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs affected 15/65, 23/65, and 21/66 participants in the 5 mg, 25 mg, and 50 mg emricasan groups, respectively, versus 16/67 with placebo. Deaths were 1, 2, and 1 versus 0.
